## Summary

When \`push_sessions\` is enabled (the default), Partio's pre-push hook calls \`git.PushBranch("origin", "partio/checkpoints/v1")\` synchronously and waits for it to finish before returning. Every \`git push\` therefore blocks until the checkpoint branch push completes. On a large checkpoint branch or a slow network connection this can add several seconds to every push.

Inspired by the background-push approach in [entireio/cli PR #2631](https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/2631).

## What to build

Decouple the checkpoint push from the user's \`git push\` by running it as a detached background process. The hook fires the push and exits immediately, without waiting. Since a failure is already treated as a warning and never fails the user's push, the background model is consistent with the existing error-handling contract.

One implementation: replace the direct \`git.PushBranch\` call in \`runPrePush\` with a detached \`exec.Cmd\` that sets \`SysProcAttr.Setpgid = true\` (or the Windows equivalent), then calls \`cmd.Start()\` without \`cmd.Wait()\`, so the subprocess runs in its own process group and outlives the hook.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] \`git push\` completes without waiting for the checkpoint branch push when \`push_sessions\` is enabled
- [ ] A checkpoint push failure does not fail the user's \`git push\` (already true; must remain so)
- [ ] The background push produces no visible output in the user's terminal during normal operation
- [ ] A unit test verifies that \`runPrePush\` returns before the spawned push process finishes

## Premise

<!-- partio:premise:v1 -->

- The pre-push hook calls \`git.PushBranch\` synchronously with no timeout [evidence: \`internal/hooks/prepush.go\`]
- \`push_sessions\` defaults to \`true\` [evidence: \`internal/config/defaults.go\`]

## Premise verification

**Claim 1**: The pre-push hook calls \`git.PushBranch\` synchronously with no timeout.

**Evidence**: \`internal/hooks/prepush.go\`:

\`\`\`go
if err := git.PushBranch("origin", git.CheckpointBranch); err != nil {
    slog.Warn("could not push checkpoint branch", "error", err)
    // Don't fail the push
}
\`\`\`

\`internal/git/push_branch.go\`:

\`\`\`go
func PushBranch(remote, branch string) error {
    _, err := execGit("push", "--no-verify", remote, branch)
    ...
}
\`\`\`

**Verdict**: holds. The call is synchronous and \`execGit\` has no timeout.

**Claim 2**: \`push_sessions\` defaults to \`true\`.

**Evidence**: \`internal/config/defaults.go\`:

\`\`\`go
StrategyOptions: StrategyOptions{
    PushSessions: true,
},
\`\`\`

**Verdict**: holds.
